name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Slow-Cooked Beef Po'Boy on New Orleans French Bread (Hold Pickles/Remoulade)
brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Slow-braised shredded beef tossed in savory beef gravy and melted cheddar on airy, soft New Orleans-style Leidenheimer French bread is very tender once you hold the tangy remoulade and pickles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Po'Boy with **NO remoulade**, **NO shredded lettuce**, and **NO pickles**, and swap the red beans & rice side for plain steamed white rice.
watchOuts: Default sandwich includes tangy/spicy remoulade, lettuce, and pickles—must order plain
